newsitem.title: INDIA: McDonnell Douglas outines new jetliner.
newsitem.headline: McDonnell Douglas outines new jetliner.

text.p: McDonnell Douglas Corporation on Friday outlined the features of its new long range jetliner named MD-XX.
"We hope to get the necessary orders (for launch) in the first part of next year and hopefully delivery will be begin in the year 2000," Allen C. Haggerty, vice-president, engineering, said.
Haggerty told a news conference that the new MD-XX would have two versions, a stretch version and a long range model.
The stretch version could carry 20 percent more passengers and baggage than the conventional MD-11 aircraft.
The efficiency of the long range model is 20 percent better than than the MD-11 model, he said.
The new aircraft would have a range of 8,600 nautical miles and a speed of Mach 0.85, officials said.
The decision to develop two models of the new aircraft was a response to the demands of the potential airline customers, Haggerty said.
Officials also said that McDonnell Douglas would source some components for the aircraft from India. No details were given.
